v45_stop_server.description: Stops the development dedicated server from inside, as an operator typing /stop would, so the toolkit's stop handler runs: rights it gave at a proven local join are taken back (OP action=revoked reason=serverStop) and ops.json ends as before the join. Needs operator level 4 (the server's op-permission-level). Expect the server to stop; the run is discarded at the stop.
